description: Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias: natural hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias. Coverage: Comunidad Autónoma de Canarias. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about natural hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zonas afectadas por el volcán de La Palma; Zonas de Alto Riesgo de Incendios (ZARI) forestales en Canarias; Proyecciones del impacto del cambio climático en la sequía en Canarias. Formats seen: TIFF, LAS, ZIP, NETCDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://datos.canarias.es/portal/aviso-legal-y-condiciones-de-uso). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
